Name: Housewarming Gifts By Mail
Author: scrotorrr
Description:
For those of you who want a little help, but don't want to full-out cheat.....
For those of you who like cheating and want to cheat a little more.....
For those of you who love getting things in the mail.....

This is the perfect mod!

Every day of Year 1, the farmer will receive a gift by mail from one of the townsfolk.  Includes a gift from Lenny (RSV), Rosa (East Scarp), and Suki (SVE).  Thanks to Rafseazz, Lemurkat, and FlashShifter for being cool with the collab :)

Plenty of food & supplies, a couple of machines, and other things you wouldn't expect!

Note, if you install this mod on an existing save, the gift delivery will begin the following day.

Thanks to Skell for their neverending patience and kindness.
